judgment.rationale: The crash path is narrowed to a cross-thread Shortcut Guide visibility check during Win-key release.
evidence: The crash path is narrowed to a cross-thread Shortcut Guide visibility check during Win-key release.
The issue is a fully reproducible crash in PowerToys.ShortcutGuide.exe whenever Win+number is pressed while taskbar labels are shown.
src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/ShortcutGuideXAML/App.xaml.cs reads OverlayWindow.AppWindow.IsVisible inside the low-level Win-key-up callback rather than on the UI thread.
The same file already marshals CloseAnimated back to OverlayWindow.DispatcherQueue, showing the code expects window operations to happen on the UI thread.
OverlayWindow.xaml.cs owns the show/hide lifecycle through ShowOverlay(), CloseAnimated(), and OnCloseTimerTick(), so a UI-thread visibility flag can replace cross-thread AppWindow property reads.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve the UI-thread visibility-state fix and implement it before more crash dumps or user repro rounds are collected.
